subject: Runapp from inside another shinny app with action button

messages.author: b332cd8e66fdab5f
messages.subject: Runapp from inside another shinny app with action button
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to call another shinny app when i push an actionbutton in a very simple shiny app. The other application is in a folder called benefits with ui.R and server.R files, but when i click the button nothing happens. Is it possible what i am trying to do??

Cheers.

ui.R
------------
library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(

  # Application title
  titlePanel("RunnApp"),
    mainPanel(
      actionButton("goButton", "Go!")
    )
 
))


library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    ntext <- eventReactive(input$goButton, {
      runApp("benefits")
  })
 
})
